name: Ham-peror
description: An enormous hamster-like Vermyn wearing a broken crown, wielding a massive bone club and a sewer-cover shield.

abilities.name: Relentless (2)
abilities.description: The Ham-peror can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

abilities.name: Sewer-Cover Shield
abilities.description: Once per GM turn, when the Ham-peror takes damage from an attack, they can mark a Stress to reduce the damage severity by one threshold. The Ham-peror raises the heavy sewer cover, catching the attack with a deafening metallic crash.

abilities.name: Ham-perial Stomp
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to leap to a point within Close range and make an attack against all targets within Melee range of where the Ham-peror lands. Targets the Ham-peror succeeds against take 1d10+2 physical damage. They become Restrained beneath the Ham-peror. A Restrained target can escape with a successful Strength or Agility Roll (13), moving them in Melee range. The Ham-peror can stand up during their spotlight, immediately ending the Restrained condition on all affected targets. The Ham-peror launches his enormous body into the air, crashes down with a sewer-shaking impact, then settles his full weight onto anyone trapped beneath him.

abilities.name: Overload
abilities.description: Before rolling damage for the Construct’s attack, you can mark a Stress to gain a +10 bonus to the damage roll. The Construct can then take the spotlight again.

abilities.name: The Crown Comes Off
abilities.description: The first time the Ham-peror marks their fifth Hit Point, they throw away the sewer-cover shield and grip the bone club with both hands. Clear 2 Stress. They can no longer use Sewer-Cover Shield, and their standard attack permanently becomes 1d12+3 physical damage. The broken crown tumbles into the wastewater. The Ham-peror stops pretending to be a king and begins fighting like a cornered beast.
